targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_weight_g) / 1000.0, 1) AS kg FROM filament_library
SELECT ROUND(SUM(remaining_weight_g) / 1000.0, 1) AS kg, ROUND(SUM(remaining_weight_g)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(total_weight_g), 0) * 100) AS pct FROM filament_library
SELECT COUNT(*) AS low_stock FROM filament_library WHERE remaining_weight_g::numeric / NULLIF(total_weight_g, 0) < 0.2
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cost_per_kg)::numeric, 2) FROM filament_library WHERE cost_per_kg IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filament_library WHERE spool_id IS NOT NULL AND spool_id != ''

SELECT COALESCE(spool_id, 'Unassigned') AS slot, ROUND(remaining_weight_g::numeric / NULLIF(total_weight_g, 0) * 100) AS remaining_pct, brand || ' ' || COALESCE(color_name, '') AS label FROM filament_library WHERE spool_id IS NOT NULL AND spool_id != '' ORDER BY spool_id
SELECT COALESCE(filament_type, 'Unknown') AS material, ROUND(SUM(filament_used_g)) AS grams FROM print_jobs WHERE filament_used_g IS NOT NULL AND start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth') AS time, COALESCE(filament_type, 'Unknown') AS material, ROUND(SUM(filament_used_g)) AS grams FROM print_jobs WHERE filament_used_g IS NOT NULL AND start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth') AS time, COALESCE(filament_type, 'Unknown') AS material, ROUND(SUM(filament_cost)::numeric, 2) AS cost FROM print_jobs WHERE filament_cost > 0 AND start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT brand || ' — ' || COALESCE(color_name, material) AS label, ROUND(remaining_weight_g::numeric / NULLIF(total_weight_g, 0) * 100) AS remaining_pct FROM filament_library ORDER BY remaining_pct ASC LIMIT 20
